mechanism.synthetic_test_action: Append literal <script>...</script><style>...</style> markup to content_html, JSON-serialize it, then embed that JSON verbatim inside an outer <script id=__NEXT_DATA__ type=application/json> element.
mechanism.html_raw_text_rule: A literal </script> sequence terminates the surrounding HTML script raw-text element regardless of JSON string quoting.
mechanism.observed_effect: ScriptJSONParser receives truncated __NEXT_DATA__ text. json.loads then raises JSONDecodeError before the content_html fragment sanitizer is exercised.
mechanism.production_extractor_implication: This failure does not demonstrate a production dual-schema extraction defect. Real frozen BLT pages and all 18 ART census pages had parseable __NEXT_DATA__ documents. The failure is in the synthetic fixture construction for this specific self-test.

strategic_process_failure.primary: We used the user-triggered host wrapper as the first dynamic execution of newly modified offline self-tests. Static review cannot prove runtime behavior of synthetic HTML/JSON fixtures.
strategic_process_failure.secondary: The self-test coupled three layers in one fixture: outer HTML script parsing, JSON hydration parsing, and inner content_html sanitization. A test intended for the innermost sanitizer failed in the outer serialization layer.
strategic_process_failure.tertiary: Earlier shared-worktree canonicalization changes also created reference-key drift. Execution-boundary documents should be single-writer/frozen before any host command is handed to the user.

if_user_approves_further_work: Create a new version only after offline dynamic validation outside the networked host boundary.
Use an HTML-script-safe JSON serializer for synthetic __NEXT_DATA__ fixtures, escaping HTML-sensitive characters such as <, >, and & before embedding.
Test visible_text_fragment script/style exclusion directly as a separate layer test, independent of outer __NEXT_DATA__ serialization.
Keep an end-to-end SCHEMA_B fixture test, but serialize it with script-context-safe JSON so json.loads reconstructs the intended content_html.
Run the full self-test dynamically in the offline Research Runner before asking the user to run any VPS command.
Only after offline PASS, freeze exact bytes and perform a small network smoke before any full 94-event rerun.
Use one canonical execution-boundary writer and no concurrent edits to the same freeze/contract/state files.
